caption: The image depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with cross-stitched embroidery, mainly featuring the alphabet and numbers. The fabric is a light beige or off-white color, with the stitched elements in different thread colors including blue, yellow, black, red, and green. The top section contains two rows of uppercase alphabet letters stitched in blue and yellow. Below these rows, there is another set of uppercase alphabet letters in black and yellow. Beneath the letters, a row of numerals from 1 to 10 is stitched in red, highlighted by a red line above and below the numbers. At the bottom of the fabric, the name "Catherine Barr." is stitched in black, flanked on either side by a small plant or tree shape in green and red. A thin border, stitched in black, frames the design, following the rectangular shape of the fabric. The background is plain and neutral, with the entire embroidered piece centered in the image.
title: Sampler
